PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: Privacy is a core principle of Gamblock-AI. This policy explains what data we process and how we protect it, in line with the data-minimisation principle of Indonesia's Data Privacy Law.
PrivacyPage.s1Body:
With separate consent, the Android Accessibility Service reads visible text from supported Chrome and Edge surfaces, including the URL bar, title, headings, and link text. That data is processed transiently for on-device AI inference, after which the app may perform Back and show a Pattern Interrupt.
URLs, domains, page text, screenshots, and browsing history are never sent to the server or an external AI service.
PrivacyPage.s2Body:
For accounts and accountability, we process data such as display name, email, group relationships, consent choices, aggregate protection counts, and system-generated block timestamps when that category is enabled. A device public key and pseudonymous thumbprint are used only to bind approval grants to the device.
These payloads never contain a URL, domain, DOM, page title, screenshot, page score, or browsing history.
PrivacyPage.s3Body:
Reflection journals and sensitive notes are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage. Protection-offboarding grants are signed by the backend, short-lived, and bound to the device's native public key.
Android Keystore and Windows CNG/DPAPI protect the relevant local key material and state.
PrivacyPage.s4Body:
Partners only see aggregate scores and statistics, never a Member's raw URLs or browsing history.
This balances accountability with user privacy.
PrivacyPage.s5Body:
You can decline Accessibility consent and continue using features that do not require it. You also have the right to access, correct, and request deletion of personal data under applicable law.
The Play edition can be uninstalled through ordinary Android controls; pilot editions have a documented administrator break-glass path. Submit data requests through the support center.
PrivacyPage.s6Body:
For privacy questions, please contact the development team via the support channels available in the app.
This policy may be updated and material changes will be communicated.

HelpPage.title: Help Center
HelpPage.intro: Find quick answers about installation, accounts, privacy, and the accountability features of Gamblock-AI.
HelpPage.s1Body:
Install the public Android edition through Google Play. The Android Research and Windows Pilot editions are installed only by the team on approved test devices.
After creating an account, read the Accessibility disclosure before choosing whether to enable browser protection, then link an Accountability Partner when needed.
HelpPage.s2Body:
Use your registered email to sign in. Forgot your password? Use the "Forgot password" link on the sign-in page to reset it.
One Member account links to one partner group at a time.
HelpPage.s3Body:
All detection runs locally on the device. Your browsing history is never sent to a server.
Reflection journals are encrypted with the AES-256-GCM standard.
HelpPage.s4Body:
In Research/Pilot editions, partner approval is the normal path to stop protection; an administrator retains a clean break-glass path. The Play edition does not prevent uninstalling through Android Settings.
Partners only see permitted aggregate statistics, never raw browsing history.
HelpPage.s5Body:
If your issue isn't resolved, reach our team via the Contact Us page.
We aim to respond as soon as possible during the program period.

DownloadPage.title: Download App
DownloadPage.intro: Gamblock-AI runs as a lightweight background service. As an academic prototype, distribution is still limited.
DownloadPage.s1Body:
The public Android edition will be available only through Google Play after review. Its opt-in Accessibility Service performs local processing on supported Chrome/Edge surfaces.
The Research APK is not a public download and is installed with team assistance only on pilot devices.
DownloadPage.s2Body:
The Windows Pilot client runs as a LocalSystem Service with SCM recovery and is installed through a signed MSI on controlled test PCs/VMs.
The Windows installer is not publicly released in this phase and must not be replaced with a ZIP or a manual installation script.
DownloadPage.s3Body:
Android 8.0+ or Windows 10/11. The AI model is under 5 MB, so it stays light on the device.
An internet connection isn't required since blocking works locally (offline).
DownloadPage.s4Body:
Gamblock-AI remains a PKM-KC 2026 prototype. Public Android availability depends on Google Play review; the Research/Windows cohort is limited to participants who complete research consent.
No debug or unsigned build is published as an end-user release.

postIntervention.title: Create space before choosing your next step
postIntervention.description: You do not have to decide anything right now. Use this short exercise to slow the urge and return to what you can control.
postIntervention.privacyBody: This page does not receive URLs, domains, page text, or browsing history.
postIntervention.groundingDescription: Three rounds, about 36 seconds. Stop at any time if it feels uncomfortable.
postIntervention.completeBody: Notice anything that changed, however small. You still control the next decision.
postIntervention.supportTitle: If the urge to access online gambling still feels strong
postIntervention.supportBody: Choose a safer environment, contact someone you trust, or open the help center. Gamblock-AI is not a substitute for professional support.
